results.title: Sweden at FIFA World Cup 2026: Blagult Squad, Potter's Project and Group F Preview | Fanorate
highlights:
FIFA World Cup
[...]
2026 Expectations
[...]
Sweden are the lowest-ranked of Group F’s European sides and face a stern test against the Netherlands and Japan. Realistically, they are fighting for second place and a Round of 16 berth. Expectations are tempered by their recent struggles and Potter’s short tenure, but the sheer quality of their attack means they cannot be written off.

Victor Lindelof
[...]
Potter is known for tactical flexibility and may experiment between a back four and a back three. Expect Sweden to be pragmatic — soaking up pressure against stronger sides and exploiting the pace of Elanga and the finishing of Gyokeres and Isak in transition. The big strategic puzzle is how to fit two elite No.9s into one system; a front two or a fluid 3-4-2-1 are plausible solutions. Defensive solidity will determine how far they go.
[...]
Battling for second in Group F — Round of 16 if the attack fires, otherwise group exit.
[...]
Sweden are the wildcard of Group F. If Potter solves the structural questions and the strikers click, they can finish second and reach the Round of 16. But the recent rebuild, midfield inexperience and a tough draw make group-stage elimination a real possibility. Expect a thrilling, high-scoring ride either way.
